name: SPD/flat pedal pair
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed average 533 g for the left/right PD-M324 SPD/Flat pedal pair, using the handbook’s explicit pair-weight row. Cleat and loose-accessory inclusion is not specified in the weight row. One face has the SPD binding and the other is a flat platform. The weight row does not identify an axle-thread variant.
